Babel named System.register fixture
====================================

This fixture is a benign source-authored ECMAScript module. It was compiled and minified without execution.

Toolchain
---------

Node.js 24.19.0 on Windows x64.
@babel/core 8.0.1.
@babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs 8.0.1.
Terser 5.50.0.

The Babel transform used moduleIds=true and moduleId="fixture/main". Terser used compress=true, mangle=true and module=false.

https://babeljs.io/docs/babel-plugin-transform-modules-systemjs/
https://github.com/systemjs/systemjs#systemregister-name-deps-declare

The isolated producer installed the three exact package versions with:

    npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

The resulting package-lock.json was 23008 bytes with SHA-256 d6ce0a75c02e4eb36f5a78af663d6e4603ee756f88319225c496f5d8781335e7.
